title: Internet Telephony in India: Chronological Evolution
authors: Voice on the Net Coalition Europe
lineage: A submission hosted by TRAI dates VSNL public Internet offering to 15 August 1995 and reports restrictions on Internet telephony. It is a third-party submission, not TRAI’s own finding.
